info.name: SpeakIT API
info.description:
# SpeakIT Production API Collection

Official Postman Collection for SpeakIT SaaS — AI Voice Generation (TTS) & Speech-to-Text (STT) Platform.

## Authentication Flow
1. **Register**: `POST /api/auth/register` initiates user registration with username, email, phone, and password.
2. **Verify Email**: `POST /api/auth/verify-email` verifies the OTP sent to email and returns the initial JWT `token`.
3. **Login**: `POST /api/auth/login` returns a JWT `token`. The test script automatically stores this in the `{{token}}` variable.
4. **Authenticated Requests**: All protected endpoints use Bearer Token auth (`{{token}}`).
5. **WebSocket Session**: `POST /api/auth/ws-ticket` issues a single-use ticket for secure WebSocket handshakes (`/ws/logout`).

## Environment Variables
- `baseUrl`: The root HTTP URL of the backend (Default: `http://localhost:8080`)
- `wsUrl`: The root WebSocket URL of the backend (Default: `ws://localhost:8080`)
- `token`: The active JWT Bearer token (populated automatically on Login/Verify Email)
- `ticket`: Single-use ticket for WebSocket connections (populated automatically on Issue WS Ticket)

## Included Domains
- Authentication & Account Lifecycles
- User Profile & Security Management
- Text-to-Speech (TTS - AWS Polly, ElevenLabs, Sarvam AI)
- Speech-to-Text & Translation (STT)
- TTS History & Analytics
- Billing & Razorpay Subscriptions
- Webhooks (Razorpay event handler)
- Contact & Enterprise Inquiries
- System Parameters (Whitelist-protected dynamic feature flags)
- WebSocket Real-Time Invalidation
- Administration & Disaster Recovery (Cloudflare R2 Log Backups)

item.description:
# 1. Authentication & Security

Comprehensive identity verification, authentication lifecycle, and security controls for the SpeakIT platform. Implements stateless JWT authentication, session versioning, email-based OTP verification, account lockout protection, and single-use WebSocket ticket provisioning.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`POST /api/auth/register`**: Registers a new user account in `PENDING_VERIFICATION` status, staging details in quarantine and dispatching a 6-digit email OTP.
- **`POST /api/auth/verify-email`**: Verifies email OTP, activates the user account, and returns the initial JWT Bearer token.
- **`POST /api/auth/login`**: Authenticates user credentials (username/email + password), increments session version, and returns an authenticated JWT Bearer token.
- **`POST /api/auth/resend-registration-otp`**: Resends a fresh email registration OTP with anti-flood rate limiting.
- **`POST /api/auth/forgot-password`**: Triggers password reset workflow by generating and emailing a secure 6-digit OTP.
- **`POST /api/auth/reset-password`**: Validates password reset OTP and atomically updates the password hash.
- **`GET /api/auth/me`**: Retrieves current authenticated profile context, role, and plan entitlements pre-cached from JWT attributes.
- **`POST /api/auth/ws-ticket`**: Issues a short-lived (60s), single-use cryptographic ticket for secure WebSocket handshakes.
- **`POST /api/auth/logout`**: Terminates the active session by incrementing session version, instantly invalidating all issued tokens across devices.
- **`GET /api/auth/ping`**: Lightweight public keep-alive health check endpoint pinged periodically to prevent cold starts.
- **`GET /api/auth/check-username`**: Real-time pre-validation checking username uniqueness and format rules without submitting a registration form.
- **`GET /api/auth/check-email`**: Real-time pre-validation checking email availability and RFC compliance.
- **`GET /api/auth/check-phone`**: Real-time pre-validation checking phone number availability and international E.164 formatting.

item.description:
# 2. User Profile Management

Endpoints for user profile inspection, avatar management, contact details updates, and password rotation. Sensitive profile modifications (such as email changes) are shielded by a two-phase challenge requiring OTP verification.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`GET /api/user/profile`**: Retrieves complete user profile details, contact information, subscription tier, and account audit metadata.
- **`POST /api/user/profile/request-update-otp`**: Dispatches an OTP verification challenge to the user prior to committing sensitive profile updates.
- **`PUT /api/user/profile`**: Applies profile modifications (full name, phone number) and stages pending email changes.
- **`POST /api/user/profile/verify-email-change`**: Validates email change OTP and promotes the staged email to primary account email.
- **`POST /api/user/profile/resend-otp`**: Resends profile modification OTP with rate limiting protection.
- **`POST /api/user/profile/change-password`**: Securely updates account password requiring verification of existing password credentials.
- **`POST /api/user/profile/cancel-changes`**: Discards unverified pending profile updates and purges staged change records.

item.description:
# 3. Text-to-Speech (TTS)

High-performance neural speech synthesis engine powered by AWS Polly (Neural Engine), ElevenLabs, and Sarvam AI. Supports both buffered MP3 generation and sub-second chunked streaming, paired with write-forward billing usage ledger enforcement.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`GET /api/tts/voices`**: Discovers all supported multi-lingual voices, neural engine availability, and regional dialects across integrated TTS providers.
- **`GET /api/tts/usage`**: Returns the current billing cycle write-forward character usage accumulators, monthly plan quotas, and remaining balances.
- **`POST /api/tts/synthesize`**: Generates high-fidelity buffered MP3 audio from input text, persists generation history, and caches audio artifacts to Cloudflare R2.
- **`POST /api/tts/synthesize/stream`**: Delivers sub-second low-latency chunked audio streaming for real-time speech playback in browsers and mobile clients.

item.description:
# 4. Speech-to-Text & Translation

Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and neural translation pipeline supporting multi-format audio files, live chunked recordings, language detection, and multi-lingual translation.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`POST /api/stt/transcribe`**: Uploads and transcribes pre-recorded audio files (MP3, WAV, M4A, WebM) with MIME validation and plan quota checks.
- **`POST /api/stt/transcribe/live`**: Transcribes live microphone audio recordings with session tracking, dialogue turn indexing, and speaker role labeling.
- **`POST /api/stt/translate`**: Translates transcribed or user-provided text across supported global languages using neural translation models.

item.description:
# 5. Analytics & History

Historical ledger and audit trail of speech synthesis conversions, character consumptions, audio URLs, and timestamps. History deletions do not alter the write-forward billing accumulators.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`GET /api/history`**: Returns paginated, indexed history of past TTS conversions with audio streaming URLs, character counts, and timestamps.
- **`DELETE /api/history/delete`**: Selectively deletes specific generation history records by ID while preserving billing ledger integrity.
- **`DELETE /api/history/clear`**: Purges all synthesis history records for the authenticated user without affecting monthly character usage accumulators.

item.name: 6. Billing & Subscriptions

request.description: Creates a new Razorpay payment order for purchasing a subscription plan.

Retrieves paginated history of transactions and plan subscriptions.

item.description:
# 6. Billing & Subscriptions

Monetization, tier entitlements, and payment processing integration powered by Razorpay. Manages subscription plans (Free, Pro, Pro Plus, Enterprise), order creation, and payment verification.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`POST /api/billing/order`**: Generates a verified Razorpay order for subscription plan upgrade, downgrade, or renewal.
- **`POST /api/billing/verify`**: Validates cryptographic Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 payment signature and activates plan tier entitlements.
- **`GET /api/billing/history`**: Retrieves historical payment transactions, order IDs, payment amounts, currencies, and invoice statuses.

item.name: 7. Webhooks

request.description: Public webhook endpoint receiving Razorpay payment events, verified with HMAC signature.

item.description:
# 7. Webhooks

Cryptographically verified server-to-server webhook event handlers. Processes asynchronous subscription events, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment failures with idempotency protection.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`POST /api/v1/webhooks/razorpay`**: Ingests and processes Razorpay webhook events (`payment.captured`, `subscription.activated`, `subscription.cancelled`) with HMAC signature verification and deduplication.

request.description:
Public contact form submission endpoint with defense-in-depth security:
1. Telegram & Discord Integration: Dispatches real-time alerts to Telegram via TelegramService and Discord Webhooks via DiscordService (topic-driven embeds, 5s timeout, up to 3 retries). Dispatches real-time alerts to the administrative Telegram channel via TelegramService (MarkdownV2 escaping, 5-second read timeout, up to 3 total attempts with 1s and 2s delays).
2. Bot Protection: Invisible honeypot field ('website') silently rejects automated bot submissions.
3. Replay Protection: Validates 'X-Request-ID' header against a 5-minute atomic in-memory cache to guarantee idempotency.
4. Anti-Spam Deduplication: SHA-256 message fingerprinting suppresses duplicate submissions from the same sender within 60 seconds.
5. Privacy Compliance: Client IP is hashed using SHA-256 before persisting to PostgreSQL ('contact_submissions').
6. Supported Topics: 'support' (Technical Support), 'billing' (Billing), 'feature' (Feature Request), 'general' (General Inquiry), 'enterprise' (Enterprise / Partnership), 'feedback' (Feedback).

item.description:
# 8. Contact & Inquiries

Customer support, enterprise sales, and partnership inquiry dispatch gateway. Equipped with enterprise defensive shielding against automated spam and bots.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`POST /api/contact`**: Dispatches customer inquiry submissions with hidden honeypot bot trap, SHA-256 anti-spam deduplication, and dual-dispatch alerting to Telegram and Discord webhooks.

item.description:
# 9. System Parameters

Dynamic runtime parameter and feature-flag distribution subsystem. Whitelist-protected parameters can be queried and updated in production without requiring server restarts, backed by Caffeine in-memory caching.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`GET /api/parameters/bulk`**: Fetches multiple approved public configuration parameters and dynamic feature flags in a single request.
- **`GET /api/parameters/{name}/live`**: Queries the database directly for the real-time value of a whitelisted configuration parameter.
- **`GET /api/parameters/{name}`**: Returns the in-memory cached value of a configuration parameter with periodic automatic synchronization.

item.name: 10. Real-Time WebSockets

request.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time session invalidation across multiple browser tabs. Handshake authenticated via single-use ticket.

item.description:
# 10. Real-Time WebSockets

Bidirectional real-time communication channels for instant security events, cross-device session termination, and live audio bridging.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`GET /ws/logout?ticket={ticket}`**: Establishes an authenticated single-use WebSocket connection to receive instant server-side logout notifications and session invalidation broadcasts.

Trigger Manual Log Backup to R2

request.description:
Disaster Recovery & Ad-Hoc Diagnostic Endpoint:
- Compresses active speakit-backend.log via in-memory GZIP stream without file locking.
- Uploads compressed snapshot to Cloudflare R2 under speakit-backend/speakit-backend-{trigger}-{TIMESTAMP}.log.gz.
- Requires authenticated JWT (Bearer token).
- Rate limited via RateLimitAction.PUBLIC.

item.description:
# 11. Administration & Operations

Disaster recovery, operational diagnostics, and administrative maintenance infrastructure. Handles automated midnight and manual active log snapshot backups to Cloudflare R2 with full database audit ledger tracking.

### Available Endpoints in this Folder:
- **`POST /api/admin/logs/backup`**: Triggers manual ad-hoc backup of the active `speakit-backend.log`. Streams and compresses log via in-memory GZIP, synchronizes exceeded rollover archive chunks, logs execution lifecycle (`IN_PROGRESS` -> `SUCCESS`/`FAILED`) in `log_backup_audits`, and uploads snapshots to Cloudflare R2 under `speakit-backend/<YYYY>/<DD-MM-YYYY>/`.
